description: This file defines the 'DataEnricherProcessor' class, which is part of the 'org.apache.fineract.infrastructure.core.service' package. The class is responsible for managing and applying a list of 'DataEnricher' instances to enrich data objects. It uses Spring Framework annotations for dependency injection and component scanning.

classes.name: DataEnricherProcessor
classes.description: A Spring component that processes data enrichment by applying a list of DataEnricher instances to a given source object. It injects the list through constructor injection and performs type-supported enrichment.

methods.name: DataEnricherProcessor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the processor with an optional list of DataEnricher objects. Uses Optional.orElse() to default to an empty list if none provided.

methods.name: enrich
methods.description: Generic method that iterates through the list of enhancers, checks if each enhancer supports the data type of the source object, and applies the enhancement if supported. Returns the potentially enriched source object.
